name: kotlin_merkletrees

tests.description: build and hash the complete default-depth Merkle-tree benchmark workload

steps.description: run recursive allocation, hashing, verification, and reporting at depths 4 through 11

tests.notes: Exercises recursive node construction, mutable cached hashes, recursive verification, repeated tree batches, long-lived object retention, Kotlin/Wasm GC objects, and WASI output. Kotlin/Wasm-WASI does not expose command arguments to this program, so the unchanged source follows its built-in depth-10 path.

source.description: Human-authored Kotlin Merkle-tree benchmark from Programming-Language-Benchmarks, distributed under the repository's MIT license.

description: Kotlin/Wasm Merkle-tree benchmark performing recursive allocation, cached hashing, verification, and repeated depth-scaled workloads.
notes: The upstream Kotlin source is compiled byte-for-byte unchanged as a raw WASI command module with no JavaScript loader or source wrapper. The pinned source repository is MIT-licensed; the Kotlin compiler and standard library are Apache-2.0. Repeated optimized builds were byte-identical.
